description: ripgrep, but also search in PDFs, E-Books, Office documents, zip, tar.gz, etc.

option.name: --version
tip: Prints version information.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Prints help information.
-h shows a concise overview; --help shows more detail.

global_option.name: --rg-help
tip: Show help for ripgrep itself.
All other options are passed directly to rg.

global_option.name: --rg-version
tip: Show version of ripgrep itself.

global_option.name: --rga-accurate
tip: Use more accurate but slower matching by mime type.
By default, rga matches files by file extension; this detects the mime type from the first 8 KiB using magic bytes.

global_option.name: --rga-adapters=
tip: Change which adapters to use and in which priority order (descending).
A bare name uses only the named adapters.
Prefix a name with + to add it to the default adapters, or - to exclude it.
Separate multiple adapters with a comma.

next.name: decompress
tip: Read a compressed file and run an extractor on its contents.

next.name: ffmpeg
tip: Extract video metadata, chapters, subtitles, lyrics, and other metadata.

next.name: mail
tip: Read mailbox/mail files and extract their contents and attachments.
Disabled by default; enable it with +mail.

next.name: pandoc
tip: Convert binary or unreadable text documents to plain text with pandoc.

next.name: poppler
tip: Extract text from PDF files with pdftotext (poppler-utils).

next.name: postprocpagebreaks
tip: Add page numbers to files that use ASCII page breaks.
Mainly used internally by the poppler adapter.

next.name: sqlite
tip: Convert sqlite databases into a simple plain text format.

next.name: tar
tip: Read a tar file as a stream and recurse into its contents.

next.name: zip
tip: Read a zip file as a stream and recurse into its contents.

global_option.name: --rga-cache-compression-level=
tip: ZSTD compression level to apply to adapter outputs before storing them in the cache database.
Ranges from 1 to 22. (default 12)

global_option.name: --rga-cache-max-blob-len=
tip: Max compressed size to cache.
Longer adapter outputs are not cached and are recomputed every time.
Allowed suffixes: k, M, G. (default 2000000)

global_option.name: --rga-cache-path=
tip: Path to store the cache database.
Defaults to the platform cache directory for ripgrep-all.

global_option.name: --rga-config-file=
tip: Path to the rga configuration file.

global_option.name: --rga-list-adapters
tip: List all known adapters.

global_option.name: --rga-max-archive-recursion=
tip: Maximum depth of nested archives to recurse into.
When searching in archives, rga recurses into archives inside archives; this limits the depth. (default 5)

global_option.name: --rga-no-cache
tip: Disable caching of results.
By default, rga caches extracted text to a database if it is small enough.

global_option.name: --rga-no-prefix-filenames
tip: Don't prefix lines of files within an archive with the path inside the archive.
Inside archives, rga prefixes each line with the file path within the archive by default.

global_option.name: --rga-print-config-schema
tip: Print the JSON Schema of the configuration file.
